# AssayNova

> AssayNova (assaynovalabs.com) is an independent analytical testing laboratory platform serving all 50 United States and Puerto Rico, providing Reversed-Phase High-Performance Liquid Chromatography (RP-HPLC-UV) purity analysis, Liquid Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry (LC-MS) molecular identity confirmation, sample request management, and public Certificate of Analysis (COA) verification via unique `AN-XXXX-XXXX` Lookup Codes.

AssayNova reports combine chromatographic separation, duplicate (`n=2`) purity and analyte content determinations, mass-spectrometric identity assessment, and optional screening panels into published analytical records verifiable directly online by Lookup Code across the US, Puerto Rico, and international research corridors.

## Service Coverage (United States & Puerto Rico)

- **Regions served**: All 50 U.S. states (`US`) and Puerto Rico (`PR`), with domestic U.S. mail-in sample coordination (USPS, FedEx, and UPS without international customs clearance for Puerto Rico submissions), plus international research partners.
- **Operating hours**: Monday-Friday, 9:00 am-5:00 pm ET / AST (`supports@assaynovalabs.com`, ~1 business day response; ~1 week typical analytical turnaround from receipt).

## Core Pages, Method Guides & Interactive Tools

- [Home](https://assaynovalabs.com/): Overview of AssayNova COA analytical testing services (`~1 week` typical turnaround), US & Puerto Rico sample intake FAQ, and COA lookup access.
- [Third-Party COA Testing Lab (US & Puerto Rico)](https://assaynovalabs.com/coa-testing): Commercial overview of independent HPLC purity, LC-MS identity, and comprehensive COA testing panels with US domestic & Puerto Rico shipping workflows.
- [RP-HPLC Purity & Net Content Testing](https://assaynovalabs.com/hplc-purity-testing): Detailed technical specifications for reversed-phase HPLC-UV chromatographic peak-area purity, calibrated net analyte mass (mg/vial), and duplicate (`n=2`) replicate reporting.
- [LC-MS Molecular Identity Testing](https://assaynovalabs.com/lc-ms-identity-testing): Electrospray ionization LC-MS monoisotopic molecular weight, multi-charge ion, and carbon-13 isotope confirmation for single analytes and blends.
- [How to Read & Verify a COA](https://assaynovalabs.com/how-to-read-a-coa): Technical guide explaining HPLC area% purity vs. calibrated net content (mg/vial), counterions, ESI-LC-MS molecular mass confirmation, duplicate repeatability, and 5-step PDF authenticity checks.
- [Cómo Leer y Verificar un COA (Español — PR y EE. UU.)](https://assaynovalabs.com/como-leer-un-coa): Spanish technical guide explaining HPLC purity vs. net content, LC-MS identity confirmation, and 5-step `AN-XXXX-XXXX` COA authenticity verification.
- [COA Purity vs. Net Content Calculator & Authenticity Checker](https://assaynovalabs.com/coa-calculator): Free browser-based calculator comparing labeled container mass, HPLC purity %, measured net content (mg), and gross powder mass, paired with a 6-point third-party COA verification checklist.
- [Laboratorio COA en Español — Puerto Rico y EE. UU.](https://assaynovalabs.com/es): Spanish-language overview of AssayNova Certificate of Analysis (COA) testing, domestic Puerto Rico shipping (USPS/FedEx/UPS), and online `AN-XXXX-XXXX` COA verification.
- [Testing Methods](https://assaynovalabs.com/testing-methods): Side-by-side overview of RP-HPLC-UV Purity Analysis, LC-MS Identity Confirmation, Comprehensive Analytical COA Panels, and pre-shipment sample preparation guidance.
- [Verify a COA](https://assaynovalabs.com/verify): Public Certificate of Analysis lookup tool using the 12-character `AN-XXXX-XXXX` Lookup Code printed on AssayNova certificates, plus supplier verification badge snippets.
- [Submit a Sample](https://assaynovalabs.com/submit-sample): Three-step analytical testing request builder for purity, identity, or comprehensive COA panels.
- [About AssayNova](https://assaynovalabs.com/about): Independent analytical governance, duplicate determination methodology, and Research Use Only (RUO) reporting standards.
- [Contact & Nova Support](https://assaynovalabs.com/contact): Client services and Nova Support (`supports@assaynovalabs.com`, Monday-Friday 9:00 am-5:00 pm ET / AST).

## COA Verification Format for Agents

- Direct verification URL pattern: `https://assaynovalabs.com/coa/AN-XXXX-XXXX` (case-insensitive `AN-` prefix followed by two 4-character alphanumeric blocks; returns `HTTP 200` for published reports and `HTTP 404` if unpublished or unknown).
- Direct published PDF URL pattern: `https://assaynovalabs.com/coa/AN-XXXX-XXXX/report.pdf` (uppercase Lookup Code; returns `application/pdf` when published).
- Lookup Codes are distinct from internal laboratory report numbers (`Report no.`) and client request references (`AN-REQ-*`).

## Optional

- [Privacy Policy](https://assaynovalabs.com/privacy-policy): Account data handling, necessary session security cookies, and optional Google sign-in disclosures.
